sources.support: pgvector is included among supported PostgreSQL13+ extension capabilities.

This exact extension release documents halfvec, sparsevec and binary vector distance operators with HNSW operator classes; the query requires distance ordering and LIMIT, with enable_seqscan=off allowed to test an index.

gap: Prior hosted coverage used vector(3) and confirmed HNSW catalog method; these cases exercise three other supplied data types and verify actual index execution on own tiny data.
limits: Fresh PG17 only; not existing-parent backfill or approximate-recall/scaling acceptance; no new issue.
